links.outcome: LLM multiple-choice accuracy with RAG versus zero-shot on ophthalmology questions
links.effect: RAG raised GPT-4-turbo accuracy by 11.54% on BCSC and 10.96% on OphthoQuestions; overall gains were 23.85% for Llama-3, 17.11% for Gemma-2 and 22.11% for Mixtral-8x7B.
links.quote: Using RAG, GPT-4-turbo's accuracy increased by 11.54% on BCSC and by 10.96% on OphthoQuestions.

unlisted_practices: Quantizing open-source LLMs (4-bit vs 8-bit) to run locally in resource-constrained environments
Zero-shot chain-of-thought prompting to improve accuracy

screen.practice: retrieval grounding (RAG) added to existing LLMs
screen.reason: Evaluates the effect of adding retrieval-augmented generation (grounding on clinical textbook) compared to base zero-shot LLMs on ophthalmic exam question-answering.
